PREEXISTING paths only, explicitly excluding the nine B2-C additions. Equal hashes are not complete before/after tree hashes including added files.

scope.ignored_test_temp_files: Only synthetic pytest SQLite files under backend/.tmp; excluded from exported inventory. No cleanup/destructive command.

first_focused.description: Initial policy classified standard invalid/withdrawn/contradictory failures as insufficiency; existing regressions caught it. No branch accepted invalid evidence.

first_combined.reason: Windows sandbox PermissionError WinError 5 at existing pytest temp fixture/cleanup; same guarded command rerun with approved execution.

tests.synthetic_legacy_regressions: Four accepted NAME/PUBLICATION ACCEPT/REJECT cases invoke unchanged service methods on synthetic SQLite only. No real or SOURCE_CLAIM decision.
tests.sqlite_limitations: Mirror omits PostgreSQL CHECKs/partial indexes/external FKs; no PostgreSQL transactional/security release guarantee.
tests.authority_limitations: All successful hybrid cases rely on explicitly synthetic server-owned authority fixture. No production authority provisioning or actual institution/human/verifier authentication was executed.

scoped_git_diff_check.note: New paths untracked; supplemented by generated-patch checks.

security.authorization_port: Trusted server integration only, never a request DTO. Existing User roles cannot establish explicit exception permission or HUMAN identity. Default denies HYBRID_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE.
security.qualification_port: Trusted current verifier-output contract; strong evidence type/boolean is not independently authenticated by this gate. No second matching engine.
security.timestamps: Explicit server-bound draft context, immutable during replay. No durable original event store yet; original timestamp authenticity and event uniqueness remain persistence blockers.
security.transactions: Fresh child ORM Session bound to caller connection, autoflush disabled, owned read SAVEPOINT only. No parent flush/expire/commit/rollback/close; unexpected errors propagate.
security.concurrency: No PostgreSQL coherent multi-query isolation or cross-process finalization guarantee. Requires separate approved transaction/locking/revocation design.
security.reason: Nonblank bounded text without control characters. Human reason is not IdentityEvidence and not a secret scanner.

checksum_policy: MANIFEST.sha256 records the six non-manifest QA artifacts including this validation after writing. Manifest self hash is reported separately; no recursive self-hash claim.
next_recommended_gate: Independent B2-C offline review; separate authority/persistence/qualification approval, then authorized disposable PostgreSQL and authenticated HTTP/E2E release gate. Not automatically started.
